UGA.note: A tender notice; it states nothing on rules or an authority for AI harms.
The AI upgrade is of a land sector information system, which belongs to the sectoral AI study, not general administration.

facts.fact: Uganda's Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development invited bids on 2026-11-02 for consultancy to supervise the upgrade of the Uganda Land Information Management Solution (UGNLIS) using blockchain and artificial intelligence.

systems.owner: Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development

UGA.note: The notice names no AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in Uganda.

facts.fact: The tender notice of 2026-11-02 states that bids by open bidding must be submitted through Uganda's e-GP portal.
